title: Aliased and reflected eval/Function calls bypassed the registry gate

reproduction.beforeFix: The source-isolation check returned pass for aliased eval and Function constructors, Reflect.apply, Reflect.construct, and Reflect.get of Function.
reproduction.afterFix: Alias- and reflection-based dynamic code execution attempts fail the source-isolation gate without evaluating the supplied code.

rootCause: Dynamic code rejection used source-text patterns for direct eval and new Function syntax without resolving aliases or reflective access to those globals.
remediation: Resolve aliases to eval and Function plus Reflect/Object method aliases in the TypeScript AST, and reject calls/construction without executing resource source.
